balls.name: Beast
balls.effect: Attaches to enemies, dealing 50–100 damage per second until it's dead.

balls.name: Bleed

balls.name: Brood Mother
balls.effect: Has a 25% chance of birthing a baby ball each time it hits an enemy.

balls.name: Burn

balls.name: Cell

balls.name: Charm

balls.name: Dark

balls.name: Earthquake

balls.name: Egg Sac

balls.name: Flesh
balls.effect: Speed increases by 25% per bounce.

balls.name: Force
balls.effect: Pierces enemies. Damage increases by 10% each time it hits an enemy (max 200%).

balls.name: Freeze

balls.name: Ghost
balls.effect: Passes through enemies.

balls.name: Iron
balls.effect: Deals double damage but moves 40% slower.

balls.name: Laser (Horizontal)
balls.effect: Deals 9–18 damage to all enemies in the same row.

balls.name: Laser (Vertical)
balls.effect: Deals 9–18 damage to all enemies in the same column.

balls.name: Light
balls.effect: Blinds enemies on hit for 3 seconds. Blinded units have a hard time detecting you and have a 50% chance of missing when they attack.

balls.name: Lightning
balls.effect: Deals 1–20 damage to up to 3 nearby enemies.

balls.name: Poison

balls.name: Stone

balls.name: Time

balls.name: Vampire

balls.name: Wind

balls.name: Wood
balls.effect: Deals 3–8 damage to nearby enemies. AOE damage increases by 10% each hit (max 200%).

balls.name: Baby Ball
balls.effect: Base attack ball, no special abilities. All characters start with a few except The Empty Nester and The Makeshift Sisyphus.

balls.name: Armageddon

balls.name: Berserk

balls.name: Blizzard

passives.effect: Increase area-of-effect damage (such as earthquake, laser, and lightning) and status effect damage (such as burn and poison) by 20%.

passives.name: Liquid Flame
passives.effect: Balls that hit flaming enemies light on fire and deal 20–30 bonus fire damage on the next hit. Orbiting balls are always on fire.

passives.name: Mystic Dipper
passives.effect: Your combined ball has a 10% chance of birthing a copy of one of its components with each bounce. Increase area-of-effect damage by 40%.

passives.name: Odiferous Shell
passives.effect: When you touch enemies, they have a 50% chance of instantly dying.

passives.name: Peacemaker
passives.effect: Balls pierce and deal 100% extra damage to the first enemy they hit.

passives.name: Phantom Regalia
passives.effect: Balls go through enemies until they hit the back wall. Balls deal 50% more damage when going through enemies.

passives.name: Reacher's Drill
passives.effect: After a ball loops around, increase its crit hit chance to 300%.

passives.name: Refracted Echo
passives.effect: After a special ball reaches its target position, 30% chance to spawn a clone from that position.

passives.name: Relentless Whip
passives.effect: Each time a special ball hits the bottom of the screen, it launches 0–2 baby balls with its properties.

passives.name: Remote Detonator
passives.effect: Enemies spawn a level 1 bomb ball upon dying.

passives.name: Sands of Time
passives.effect: Balls deal more damage the faster they move (up to 200%).

passives.name: Shadow Blade
passives.effect: Increase crit chance to 700% when hitting enemies in the back.

passives.name: Soul Reaver
passives.effect: Each kill heals you by 1 and you can heal past your max health at 30% efficiency.

passives.name: Spiked Shield
passives.effect: Increase shield size by 50%. Whenever you bounce a special ball, eject a spike at a random enemy that deals 50–90.

passives.name: Teardrop Dagger
passives.effect: Balls deal 100% more damage and move 20 faster when on a return trajectory.

passives.name: Tilted Dagger
passives.effect: When balls hit enemies on their right side, increase crit chance to 600% and bounce horizontally.

passives.name: Tormenters Mask
passives.effect: Enemies have a 10% chance of dying immediately the first time they detect you.

passives.name: Vampire's Kiss
passives.effect: Whenever bleed is applied, add 3 extra stacks. Dealing bleed damage has a 2% chance of healing 1 health.

passives.name: Volatile Explosive
passives.effect: Enemies create a large explosion on death, dealing 40–60 damage to nearby enemies.

passives.name: Windweaver
passives.effect: Shoot a level 1 wind ball every time you pick up a gem.

passives.name: Wings of the Anointed
passives.effect: Balls move 40% faster and you move 20% faster. No longer affected by environmental hazards on the ground.

characters.name: The Warrior
characters.quirk: Default character, no special gameplay quirks.

characters.name: The Itchy Finger
characters.quirk: Scattered aim, shoots twice as fast, auto-launches balls; full speed while shooting.

characters.name: The Repentant
characters.quirk: Balls deal +5% damage per bounce; on hitting the back wall they return, damaging enemies passed through.

characters.name: The Cohabitants
characters.quirk: Each launched ball is mirrored by a copy; balls deal half damage.

characters.name: The Cogitator
characters.quirk: Automatically chooses upgrades.

characters.name: The Embedded
characters.quirk: Balls always pierce enemies until they hit a wall.

characters.name: The Shade
characters.quirk: Balls shoot from the back; base crit chance 10%.

characters.name: The Shieldbearer
characters.quirk: Large shield bounces back balls that hit it.

characters.name: The Spendthrift
characters.quirk: Shoots all balls at once in a wide arc.

characters.name: The Juggler
characters.quirk: Lobs balls at a target position; no bouncing until landing.

characters.name: The Empty Nester
characters.quirk: No baby balls. Each shot shoots multiple instances of one equipped special ball.

characters.name: The Flagellant
characters.quirk: Balls bounce normally off the bottom of the screen.

characters.name: The Makeshift Sisyphus
characters.quirk: No baby balls. No direct hit damage; AOE and status damage ×4.

characters.name: The Physicist
characters.quirk: Balls are affected by gravity toward the back of the screen.

characters.name: The Tactician
characters.quirk: Battles become turn-based.

characters.name: The Radical
characters.quirk: Plays the game and chooses upgrades automatically (AI plays).

characters.name: The Falconer
characters.quirk: Balls shot from two falcons on the sides of the screen.

characters.name: The Carouser
characters.quirk: Balls can briefly orbit the player on return trajectory.

characters.name: The Tunneller
characters.quirk: Balls wrap around top and bottom of the screen.

characters.name: The Tiptoer
characters.quirk: Undetectable by enemies (except bosses/minibosses); drastically less health.

characters.name: The Hoary Hoarder
characters.quirk: Only 2 ball slots; remaining equipment slots become passive slots.

characters.name: The Ballbearer
characters.quirk: Twice as many ball slots, but no passive slots.

characters.name: The False Messiah
characters.quirk: Twitch audience votes on choices and random events.

characters.name: The Conduit
characters.quirk: Area-of-effect damage from balls is centered on the player.

characters.name: The Potager
characters.quirk: All equipped special balls are fused into one ball when shot. Cannot fuse balls normally, and has no baby balls.

characters.name: The Recollector
characters.quirk: Balls return to you after reaching your aim cursor, piercing enemies there and back.

characters.name: The Right Hand Man
characters.quirk: After hitting the right wall, balls deal double damage. After hitting the left wall, balls deal half damage and go through enemies.

characters.name: The Scandalmonger
characters.quirk: Balls can briefly orbit around the aim cursor when on a return trajectory.

characters.name: The Scrupulous Scoundrel
characters.quirk: Balls only bounce in perfect diagonals.

characters.name: The Sentinel
characters.quirk: Can aim and shoot in any direction (including behind you).

characters.name: The Wallbreaker
characters.quirk: Balls teleport to the opposite side of the screen the first time hitting a wall.

level3.armageddon: Creates a meteor shower upon hitting an enemy. The meteor shower lasts for 5 seconds and deals 50–70 damage/second to enemies within a 3 tile radius.
level3.ash: Goes through enemies and leaves behind a trail of ash for the first 5.0 seconds after being launched. Ash lasts for 6.0 seconds and applies 1 stack of burn per second (max 4 stacks). Burn lasts for 8 seconds. Burnt units are dealt 4–7 damage per stack per second.
level3.assassin: Passes through the front of enemies, but not the back. Backstabs deal 50% bonus damage.
level3.banished-flame: Add 1 stack of darkflame on hit for 2 seconds (max 8 stacks). Darkflame deals 1–35 damage per stack per second. When the darkflame goes out, it deals 1–100 to the enemy.
level3.banshee: Curses all enemies while on the field when launched. Cursed enemies are dealt 250–400 after being hit 6 times.
level3.beast: Attaches to enemies, dealing 100–200 damage per second until it's dead.
level3.berserk: Each hit has a 40% chance of causing enemies to go berserk for 9 seconds. Berserk enemies deal 23–32 damage to adjacent enemies every second.
level3.black-hole: Instantly kills the first non-boss enemy that it hits, but destroys itself afterwards. Has a 5 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.bleed: Inflicts 4 stacks of bleed. Bleeding enemies receive 1 damage per stack when hit by a ball (max 14 stacks).
level3.blizzard: Freezes all enemies within a 2 tile radius for 1.3 seconds, dealing 1–70 damage.
level3.bomb: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 200–400 damage to nearby enemies. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.brimstone: Applies 1 stack of burn and poison every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius (max 4 stacks). Burn deals 1–7 damage per stack per second and poison deals 3–5 damage per stack per second.
level3.brood-mother: Has a 45% chance of birthing a baby ball each time it hits an enemy.
level3.bullet: Pierces enemies. Initially deals 1200% damage. Damage erodes by 200% each time hitting an enemy (minimum 100%).
level3.burn: Add 1 stack of burn on hit for 5 seconds (max 5 stacks). Burnt units are dealt 7–11 damage per stack per second.
level3.catapult: Launches 4–6 stone baby balls every 1.5 seconds, which are destroyed after hitting anything.
level3.cell: Splits into a clone on hit 4 times.
level3.charm: Each hit has a 5% chance of charming the enemy for 7 seconds. Charmed units walk up the board and attack enemies.
level3.dark: Deals 5.0x damage but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.drill: Pierces enemies and deals 100% bonus damage until reaching the back of the field.
level3.earthquake: Deals 9–17 damage to nearby units in a 4x4 tile square.
level3.egg-sac: Explodes into 3–5 baby balls on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.elemental: Applies a random status effect (burn, slow, or freeze) to nearby enemies on hit.
level3.erosion: Passes through enemies. Deals 5% of enemy's current health as bonus damage on hit.
level3.fireworks: Explodes into 4–8 fireworks. Fireworks target random enemies, dealing 20–30 damage and applying 1 stack of burn. Burnt units are dealt 10–14 damage per stack per second.
level3.flash: Damage all enemies on screen for 2–4 damage after hitting an enemy and blind them for 3 seconds.
level3.flesh-mound: Emits a fleshy baby ball in a random direction every 0.6 seconds.
level3.flicker: Deals 2–10 damage to every enemy on screen every 1.2 seconds.
level3.force: Pierces enemies. Damage increases by 15% each time it hits an enemy (max 300%).
level3.freeze: Has a 7% chance to freeze enemies for 8.0 seconds. Frozen enemies receive 25% more damage.
level3.freeze-ray: Emits a freeze ray when hitting an enemy, dealing 25–65 to all enemies in its path, with a 10% chance of freezing them for 13.0 seconds.
level3.frozen-flame: Add 1 stack of frostburn on hit for 30 seconds (max 5 stacks). Frostburnt units are dealt 10–16 damage per stack per second and receive 25% more damage from other sources.
level3.fruit: Destroyed after hitting 4 enemies, but heals you by 6 if it returns to you.
level3.gale: Knocks enemies into the air briefly, allowing balls to pass under them. Enemies are hurt for 150–200 damage upon falling back to the ground.
level3.glacier: Releases glacial spikes over time that deal 25–40 to enemies that touch them and freeze them for 3.0 seconds. This ball and its glacial spikes also deal 6–12 damage to nearby units.
level3.heart-swallower: Saps enemies on hit, with a 70% chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 40%. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
level3.hedgehog: Inflicts 5 stacks of bleed (max 14 stacks) and emits 2–4 spiky baby balls on hitting an enemy.
level3.hemorrhage: Inflicts 4 stacks of bleed. When hitting an enemy with 12 stacks of bleed or more, consumes all stacks of bleed to deal 20% of their current health.
level3.holy-laser: Deals 30–60 damage to all enemies in the same row and column.
level3.incubus: Each hit has a 5% chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Charmed enemies curse nearby enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 150–250 after being hit 5 times.
level3.inferno: Applies 1 stack of burn every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius. Burn lasts for 10 seconds, dealing 6–10 damage per stack per second.
level3.iron: Deals double damage but moves 30% slower.
level3.ironwood: Deals 15–20 damage to nearby enemies. AOE damage increases by 15% each hit (max 300%).
level3.ivy: Applies 1 stack of ivy. Each stack deals 1–4 damage per second. Upon reaching 4, consume all stacks and deal 130–200 damage to all nearby enemies.
level3.kaiju: Moves slowly and deals triple damage. Deals 70–180 damage to nearby units every second.
level3.landslide: Creates a landslide and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The landslide lasts for 5 seconds and deals 30–40 damage/second to enemies within a 2 tile radius.
level3.laser-horizontal: Deals 13–34 damage to all enemies in the same row.
level3.laser-vertical: Deals 13–34 damage to all enemies in the same column.
level3.laser-beam: Emit a laser beam on hit that deals 46–66 damage and blinds enemies for 8 seconds.
level3.laser-cutter: Constantly emits a laser in front of it, which deals 140–210 per second.
level3.leech: Attaches up to 1 leech onto enemies it hits, which adds 3 stacks of bleed per second (max 48 stacks).
level3.light: Blinds enemies on hit for 7 seconds. Blinded units have a hard time detecting you and have a 50% chance of missing when they attack.
level3.lightning: Deals 1–30 damage to up to 5 nearby enemies.
level3.lightning-bug: Spawns a lightning bug each time it hits an enemy. Lightning bugs attack a random enemy, dealing 1–100 damage to up to 4 nearby enemies.
level3.lightning-rod: Plants a lightning rod into enemies it hits. These enemies are struck by lightning every 2.5 seconds, dealing 1–40 damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.
level3.lovestruck: Inflicts lovestruck on hit enemies for 30 seconds. Lovestruck units have a 50% chance of healing you for 8 health when they attack.
level3.maggot: Infest enemies on hit with maggots. When they die, they explode into 2–3 baby balls.
level3.magma: Emits lava blobs over time. Enemies who walk into lava blobs are dealt 20–35 damage and gain 1 stack of burn (max 3 stacks). Burn lasts for 3 seconds, dealing 5–10 damage per stack per second. This ball and its lava blobs also deal 6–12 damage to nearby units.
level3.misfortune: Deals 6.0x damage and curses all enemies on first hit, destroying self afterwards. Cursed enemies are dealt 20–40 damage after being hit 5 times. 4 second cooldown.
level3.mosquito-king: Spawns a mosquito each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 100–150 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 2 health.
level3.mosquito-kingdom: Spawns 2–3 mosquitos each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 100–150 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 2 health.
level3.mosquito-swarm: Explodes into 4–8 mosquitos. Mosquitos attack random enemies, dealing 100–150 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health.
level3.mudslide: Creates a mudslide and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The landslide lasts for 5 seconds and deals 40–50 damage/second to enemies and slowing them within a 2 tile radius.
level3.nosferatu: Spawns a vampire bat each bounce. Vampire bats fly towards a random enemy, dealing 180–272 damage on hit, turning into a Vampire Lord.
level3.noxious: Passes through enemies and applies 3 stacks of poison to nearby enemies within a 2 tile radius. Poison lasts for 6 seconds and each stack deals 2–5 damage per second.
level3.nuclear-bomb: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 400–700 damage to nearby enemies and applying 1 stack of radiation to everyone present indefinitely (max 5 stacks). Each stack of radiation increases damage received by 15%. Has a 3 second cooldown.
level3.offspring: Splits into a clone on hit 6 times.
level3.overgrowth: Applies 1 stack of overgrowth. Upon reaching 2, consume all stacks and deal 180–250 damage to all enemies in a 3x3 tile square.
level3.petrify: Petrifies all enemies within its sightline for 2.0 seconds when first launched, dealing 80–180.
level3.phantom: Curse enemies on hit. Cursed enemies are dealt 200–300 damage after being hit 5 times.
level3.poison: Applies 1 stack of poison on hit (max 8 stacks). Poison lasts for 9 seconds and each stack deals 2–5 damage per second.
level3.radiation-beam: Emit a radiation beam on hit that deals 36–72 damage and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks). Radiation lasts for 15 seconds and cause enemies to receive 10% more damage from all sources per stack.
level3.reaper: Has a 15% chance to kill enemies on impact, healing you for 7 health.
level3.rot: Deals 30% of enemy's current health as bonus damage but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. 5 second cooldown.
level3.sacrifice: Inflicts 6 stacks of bleed (max 20 stacks) and applies curse to hit enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 75–125 after being hit 5 times.
level3.sandstorm: Goes through enemies and is surrounded by a raging storm dealing 15–30 damage per second and blinding nearby enemies for 4 seconds.
level3.satan: While active, add 1 stack of burn to all active enemies per second (max 5 stacks), dealing 15–30 damage per stack per second and make them go berserk, dealing 21–30 damage to adjacent enemies every second.
level3.shotgun: Shoots 5–9 iron baby balls after hitting a wall. Iron baby balls move at 200% speed but are destroyed upon hitting anything.
level3.siren: Goes through enemies. Each hit has a 7.5% chance of charming the enemy for 12 seconds.
level3.sniper: Pierces enemies and shoots 5–9 sniper baby balls after hitting a wall. Sniper baby balls pierce enemies but are destroyed upon hitting a wall.
level3.soul-sucker: Passes through enemies and saps them, with a 50% chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 40%. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
level3.spider-queen: Has a 45% chance of birthing an Egg Sac each time it hits an enemy.
level3.stalagmite: Deals 25–30 damage to nearby units in a 4x4 tile square and knocks them into the air briefly, allowing balls to pass under them.
level3.steam: Goes through enemies and leaves behind a trail of steam for the first 6.0 seconds after being launched. Steam lasts for 8.0 seconds and deals 30–60 damage per second.
level3.steel: Initially deals double damage but moves 50% slower. Damage increases by 15% each time it hits an enemy (max 400%).
level3.stone: Initially deals 400% damage. Damage erodes by 30% each time hitting an enemy (minimum 50%).
level3.storm: Emits lightning to strike nearby enemies every second, dealing 1–80 damage.
level3.succubus: Each hit has a 5% chance of charming the enemy for 12 seconds. Heals 1 when hitting a charmed enemy.
level3.sun: Blind all enemies in view and add 1 stack of burn every second (max 5 stacks). Burn lasts for 8 seconds and deals 9–15 damage per stack per second.
level3.swamp: Leaves behind tar blobs over time. Enemies who walk into tar blobs are dealt 25–40, are slowed by 50% for 7 seconds and gain 1 stack of poison (max 8 stacks). Each stack of poison deals 2–4 damage per second. This ball and its tar blobs also deal 6–12 damage to nearby units.
level3.thunderbird: Attaches to enemies, dealing 120–200 damage per second while emitting lightning that deals 1–80 damage to nearby enemies.
level3.time: Explodes into a time snare upon hitting an enemy, which stays on the field for 3.0 seconds and freezes enemies inside it.
level3.time-bomb: Throws a time bomb every few seconds, which explodes after a delay, dealing 140–240 damage to nearby enemies.
level3.timestop: Freezes everything on the field for 6.0 seconds but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 20 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.tsunami: Goes through enemies and deals 90–170 damage in a large area, but is destroyed upon hitting an edge of the field.
level3.tumor: Applies tumor on hit. Enemies with a tumor die after 30 seconds (except for bosses).
level3.vampire: Each hit has a 6% chance of healing 2 health.
level3.vampire-lord: Each hit inflicts 4 stacks of bleed. Heals 1 health and consumes all stacks when hitting an enemy with at least 9 stacks of bleed.
level3.venom: Applies 1 stack of venom on hit (max 12 stacks). Each stack deals 4–7 damage per second and slows down enemies.
level3.virus: Applies 1 stack of disease to units it hits (max 8 stacks). Disease lasts for 6 seconds. Each stack of disease deals 5–9 damage per second and diseased units have a 25% chance of passing a stack to undiseased nearby enemies each second.
level3.voluptuous-egg-sac: Explodes into 3–4 egg sacs on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.warp: After each hit, warps to a random spot on the field and speeds up by 10%.
level3.water: Explodes into 4–6 baby water balls on hitting an enemy, dealing 40–110 damage to nearby enemies. Baby water balls deal reduced damage to an area around them on hit. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
level3.water-bug: Births a baby ball each time it hits an enemy.
level3.waterfall: Creates a waterfall and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The waterfall lasts for 8.0 seconds and deals 20–25 damage/second to enemies within a 2 tile radius.
level3.werewolf: Attaches to enemies, dealing 150–200 damage per second until it's dead. 40% chance to heal you for 3 when target dies.
level3.wind: Passes through enemies and slows them down by 45% for 8 seconds, but deals 25% less damage.
level3.wolfpack: Spawns with 2 other copies. Attaches to enemies, dealing 100–200 damage per second until it's dead.
level3.wood: Deals 6–11 damage to nearby enemies. AOE damage increases by 10% each hit (max 200%).
level3.wraith: Freezes any enemy it passes through for 1.8 seconds.
level3.x-ray: Emits an X-shaped laser on hit, which deals 60–95 damage to enemies and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks). Radiation causes enemies to receive 10% more damage from all sources per stack.
level3.zombie: Infects enemies on hit, giving them a 60% chance to turn into a friendly zombie on death.
